notes: 2 Chronicles 24:8 8 And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.
2 Chronicles 24:16 16 And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.

25 And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
